notes.title: Power Drill Massacre Demo At the Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hey, listen up! The Power Drill Massacre demo ain't ready for today, guys. The devs hit a few snags with some pesky technical stuff that needs some extra time to sort out. But hold on tight, fellas! They're busting their asses to fix things up real good and give you a kickass gameplay experience. Now, here's the scoop: mark your calendars for Wednesday 'cause that's when this bad boy's gonna drop. Get ready to dive into some hardcore, blood-pumping horror, my dudes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42566870/954fa2a0d55c6901f4a5b5ec2f2b814abb395018.jpg[/img]

While you're eagerly waiting for the Power Drill Massacre demo to hit the scene, I've got a solid recommendation for you, my friend. Check out the Sniper Killer demo published by Torture Star Video and developed by Black Eyed Priest. It's a gripping experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat with its intense sniper action. Trust me, it's a real thrill ride that'll help keep your adrenaline pumping until Wednesday rolls around. Give it a shot and let the bullets fly!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389570/Sniper_Killer/

notes.title: Power Drill Massacre Playthrough
notes.notes:
The Power Drill Massacre is a heart-pumping slasher horror game from Puppet Combo inspired by vhs slasher films and PS1 survival horror games. 

Injured after a car crash, Megan flees through the woods into an abandoned building, looking for help. The door jams and she's locked inside, forced to search through the dark corridors. She hears the echo of a power drill in the distance and realizes she's not alone.

Come watch a playthrough of Puppet Combo's latest release and make sure to bring bandages, its going to get bloody.
